name: TCG 2005 (Goat era)
description: The rule behaviour EDOPro/ocgcore uses for GOAT-format duels: the DUEL_MODE_GOAT composite, i.e. the Master Rule 1 baseline plus eleven TCG-specific era behaviours. Selecting the 'GOAT' Duel Rule preset in EDOPro's host dialog produces exactly this flag set.

era.official_ruleset_label: Pre-Master Rule TCG expert rules (era attribution of individual flags to official rulebook revisions is still unsourced; the flag composition below is what the engine confirms)

differences_from_modern.summary: The turn player may activate ignition effects with priority (e.g. immediately after a summon) before the opponent can respond; the TCG variant applies at any empty-chain point and from any location.
The turn-1 player draws in their first Draw Phase.
Only one Field Spell can be face-up at a time; activating one destroys the previous one by rule.
Two 0-ATK monsters battling each other are both destroyed.
Simultaneous-trigger (SEGOC) chains are built with TCG ordering: non-public triggers join the same pass and only triggers from the earliest event go on the chain.

known_gaps.summary: Deck construction limits, forbidden card types and banlists are not engine flags; they are enforced client-side and must be configured by the host (the GOAT preset applies them automatically).
Attribution of each flag to a dated official rulebook/ruling change is unresearched; the engine encodes mechanics, not history. Era-accuracy of the composite is Project Ignis's curation.

notes: Flag expansion verified against ocgapi_constants.h:379-428 (DUEL_MODE_GOAT = DUEL_MODE_MR1 | 11 flags, computed 0x7F80D072C). The validator/tests recompute this expansion from the pinned ocgcore header facts.
